svg.title: FR1 retained load, finite support and stopped screen
svg.text: FR1 retained load, finite support and stopped screen
Recorded scalar screens only; support springs are sensitivities, not measured installed stiffness
A WHICH LOAD IS ACTUALLY RETAINED?
8.83 N m came from a legacy 90 mm planform rescaled onto this 60 mm fin; do not substitute the smaller direct case.
B FINITE SUPPORT MODEL — NOT A FIXED WALL
1 to 10 MN/m; ring ends not fixed
Estimated mount rotation stiffness 146.468 N m/rad assumes rigid ring-end rotations; actual compliance lowers it.
C TOTAL TIP MOVEMENT AT RETAINED 8.83 N m
Best finite 1.185 mm short-tab sensitivity fails 1 mm; extra aft-end rotational restraint is uncredited.
Rigid ideal 0.901 mm is diagnostic. Complete installed displacement is unavailable; failed sensitivity is not physical impossibility.
Actual 130 mm body root: one-face mean 1.125 MPa > 1.000 MPa estimate. Record subregion 109.4 mm: 1.337 MPa.
Aft filled bond 50.682 mm²: 50.682 N mean-shear / 0.1466 N m elastic pure-moment screens at 1 MPa; capacity unknown.
204-11 CLT unit interpretation, hot finished modulus/strength, local peel, ring stiffness and partition remain unqualified.
Identity: RP1-FR1-monolithic-carbon-v1 | dimensions mm; ledger g; recorded loads N
Source/build/offline artifact only. No browser, installed strength, thermal or flight acceptance.
